# Cabal

> Cabal (cabal.army) is a social radar for Solana memecoins: the community posts upcoming launches with a date and time, so members see them before they go live. It is currently in early access with a waitlist; you sign up with your X account.

## What it offers

- Launch radar: launches posted by the community before they go live.
- Dev track records: each dev's real history.
- Points redeemable for $CABAL.
- Live streams on launch day.
- A Telegram/Discord bot with launch alerts.
